verdicts.title: Formulas for the Walsh coefficients of smooth functions and their application to bounds on the Walsh coefficients
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We establish formulas for the $b$-adic Walsh coefficients of functions in $C^α[0,1]$ for an integer $α\geq 1$ and give upper bounds on the Walsh coefficients of these functions. We also study the Walsh coefficients of periodic and non-periodic functions in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns b-adic Walsh coefficients of smooth real-valued functions on [0,1] in C^α and reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, not Boolean Walsh spectra of unit-propagation indicators or DPLL leaf counts.

verdicts.title: On the Walsh and Fourier-Hadamard Supports of Boolean Functions From a Quantum Viewpoint
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
In this paper, we focus on the links between Boolean function theory and quantum computing. In particular, we study the notion of what we call fully-balanced functions and analyse the Fourier--Hadamard and Walsh supports of those functions having such property. We study the Walsh and Fourier supports of other relevant classes of functions, using what we call balancing sets.
